linkedin_caption:
mcpsnoop is a live traffic inspector for MCP. Wrap your server command with it and watch every JSON-RPC frame your AI client and server actually exchange, in a terminal UI.

Here is the thing that got me. The official MCP Inspector connects as its own separate client. It never sees what your real client sent. A tool that silently never got called. A call with the wrong arguments. A request that just hangs. None of that shows up on the official inspector. mcpsnoop sits in the real path instead, so it catches all of it live.

Nine days old, already at 197 stars off a single Show HN post. Worth a look if you build or debug anything on MCP.
